questions.question_text: Mrs. Mantilla owns the pharmacy where Yohan works. She gave him the job and pays him every Friday, but an older worker trains him. Mrs. Mantilla is Yohan's ___.
Yohan is new at the pharmacy, gets nervous easily and has classes every morning. But when he promises something, he does it. His manager says he is very ___.

borrador.title: [BORRADOR] b1-u01 · Your First Job Interview · Vocabulario 3 · repaso

borrador.description: On the morning of her interview, Leidy arrived at Café del Oriente twenty minutes early. She has worked as a part-time cashier since last year, so she wasn't a complete beginner, but she still felt nervous. Mr. Rangel welcomed her warmly and offered her a cup of coffee. During the interview, he asked about her studies and her experience, and Leidy answered every question with confidence. She didn't ask about the salary, but she did ask an indirect question about the schedule. After thirty minutes, Mr. Rangel thanked her and said, 'We will call you this week.'

questions.question_text: Leidy arrived ten minutes early for her interview.
Mr. Rangel offered Leidy a cup of coffee.
Leidy went to the interview by bus.

borrador.title: [BORRADOR] b1-u01 · Your First Job Interview · Lectura 1

borrador.description: Two days after the interview, Leidy was at her cashier job when her phone rang. It was Mr. Rangel from Café del Oriente. He said the team liked her answers about teamwork, and he offered her the internship. Leidy accepted at once and asked one last indirect question: 'I'd like to know if I could start the following Monday.' Mr. Rangel said yes. That evening, Leidy called her friend Dayana to tell her the good news.

questions.question_text: Mr. Rangel called Leidy three days after the interview.
Leidy asked to start the following Monday.
Leidy's friend Dayana lives in Floridablanca.
